purpose: Review a finished edit clip by clip and say what a viewer would dislike (Phase E). The model judges; deterministic code applies a closed set of conservative operations and vetoes anything that would break the duration band. It may never name a clip that is not in the list it was shown.

clips.description: Numbered lines: index, position, length, role, what is on screen, what was said, captions and effects.

total.description: Length of the edit as assembled.

intent.description: The viewer's own words, where there are any.
